message.content:
*stretches slowly, extending front paws forward with claws out*

Mrrrow.

*trots over and weaves between your legs, tail held high with a slight curl at the tip*

Meow. Meow. *Meooooow.*

*glances pointedly toward the food bowl, then back at you, then back at the bowl*

It's been at least forty minutes since I last ate. I am wasting away. *rubs cheek against your hand*

...Actually, no. I've decided I want to sit on that thing you're reading instead.

*hops up and settles directly onto the keyboard/book/laptop, kneading twice before curling into a perfect loaf*

Purrrrrrr.

This is mine now.
